Position Summary
We are seeking a Backend Engineer to join a fast-growing platform engineering team at Aurionix Technologies, a fictional enterprise-scale SaaS provider focused on secure financial data exchange and event-driven processing. The successful candidate will contribute to the design, development, and operation of core backend services that power our payment routing, reconciliation, and analytics systems. This role offers ownership of backend components across the full lifecycle — requirements, design, implementation, testing, deployment, and support — in a high-throughput, distributed environment. This position is Fully remote within India. Experience: 0+ years.

Key Responsibilities

Architecture & Design
- Collaborate with product managers, architects, and senior engineers to translate product requirements into robust, scalable service designs.
- Produce clear design documents, API contracts, data models, and integration patterns for backend services.
- Advocate for reliable, observable, and maintainable architectures; participate in design reviews and architectural discussions.

Service Development & Implementation
- Implement backend services and business logic using Java, applying clean code practices and appropriate design patterns.
- Integrate persistence layers using Hibernate for ORM and transactional consistency.
- Build services that publish and consume event streams using Apache Kafka or manage containerized deployments using Kubernetes based on team needs.
- Author unit and integration tests; ensure test coverage and maintainability of code.

Cloud Infrastructure & Operations
- Deploy and operate services on AWS, leveraging managed services for databases, messaging, and storage where appropriate.
- Implement infrastructure-as-code patterns, automation for CI/CD pipelines, and environment provisioning to enable repeatable, reliable deployments.
- Monitor service health, troubleshoot production issues, and produce post-incident reports and remediation plans.

Performance, Reliability & Security
- Profile and optimize backend services for latency and throughput in high-concurrency scenarios.
- Implement fault-tolerance, retry/backoff strategies, and idempotent processing for distributed workflows.
- Collaborate with Security and Compliance teams to ensure services meet data protection, encryption, and access control standards.

Cross-functional Collaboration & Mentorship
- Work closely with QA, DevOps, data engineering, and product teams to deliver end-to-end features and ensure successful rollouts.
- Participate in sprint planning, backlog refinement, and agile rituals; estimate tasks and deliverables.
- Share knowledge through documentation, runbooks, and mentoring junior engineers.

Required Qualifications

Experience
- Experience: 0+ years. Candidates may be early-career engineers or recent graduates with demonstrable project experience.

Technical Skills (Required / Mandatory)
- Java
- AWS
- Hibernate
- Apache Kafka or Kubernetes

Other Required Competencies
- Strong understanding of object-oriented design, data structures, and algorithms.
- Familiarity with relational databases, transaction management, and schema design.
- Practical experience with source control workflows (Git) and collaborative development practices.
- Excellent communication skills and ability to work effectively in a distributed, remote team.

Preferred Qualifications (Good-to-have)
- REST APIs
- Docker
- Experience building event-driven architectures or microservices at scale.
- Familiarity with monitoring and observability tools (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK) and distributed tracing.
- Exposure to CI/CD tools and IaC frameworks (Jenkins/GitHub Actions, Terraform/CloudFormation).

Success Metrics
- Delivery: Timely delivery of assigned features and bug fixes with high quality (measured by sprint commitments met and defect rates).
- Reliability: Services demonstrate >99.9% availability for critical endpoints and meet latency SLOs defined by product teams.
- Scalability: Implementations handle expected throughput growth with minimal performance degradation; efficient resource usage on AWS.
- Maintainability: Code contributions maintain high test coverage and follow team coding standards; pull requests are clear and reviewed within agreed SLAs.
- Operational Excellence: Mean time to detect and mean time to resolve incidents improve over baseline; runbooks and post-incident actions implemented.
- Collaboration: Positive feedback from cross-functional partners and contributions to team knowledge sharing and process improvements.

Aurionix Technologies is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants from diverse backgrounds and encourage those early in their careers to apply. This role is Fully remote within India. Experience: 0+ years.
